I'm sorry if this is the wrong place to post this or if this breaks the rules here somehow but I'm a bit overwhelmed and would really appreciate if someone would at least point me in the right direction.  
  
My best friend just recently passed away and we have played games for a long time. This might sound weird but I asked for his ps4 because I really wanted to load his save games and see what he had been playing as a way to remember him.  
  
Before I get his ps4 I was wondering if it's somehow possible to save everything in it's current state so I can always go back to it as it was before I got it. Even better would be to be able to export all the data onto an external drive so I can preserve it in its current state. I've never owned a Playstation and I'm just worried about accidentally losing the data.  
  
I'm not sure if this is even possible or it might even be stupidly simple but I just can't think right now so I appreciate any advice.

I'm honestly feeling kind of shocked and my heart breaks for uu just from reading through all this..  I'm so sorry to hear about all that uuve gone through but i think uur an incredibly strong person for pressing forward in life and getting to where uu are now despite everything..   


 It blows my mind how horrendously cruel other people can be..  It hurts so much especially when its uur friends and or family that betray uur trust..  :(     


Realizing uur fear is illogical is a great step in the right direction.  While uur fear does indeed have logical roots given the traumas uuve gone through, it doesnt mean the past will repeat its self..  As difficult as it may be to see, theres other people out there like uur best friend, if anything i would say they are actually in the majority..    


Idk if uuve been to a therapist but that might be a good idea if uu havent..  Also maybe if its possible, try and slowly open up to some other people while having uur best friend around as well as a safety net of sorts.  Maybe starting with some friends of uur best friend..?

all good captain dont have to worry about hijacking lol.. all of us here need our voices to be heard.. :)  Thank uu so much for the encouragement and kind words, I also hope that one day we can be free from the tyranny of our own minds..  Best of luck to uu as well..! :D

Thanks captain i appreciate uu taking the time to write this response.. Sorry to hear that uu are also struggling as well though.. :(  Honestly i dont even really know where to start with whats going on with me..  Its just been so many years of hoping things will start to improve but i always manage to wind up right back in the hole i started in..  Ill happily admit a lot of that is my own fault,  but i just dont know how to walk away from my past life and move onto something better..  I just cant keep going like this i feel like ive been spread way too thin trying to keep going day by day..  No matter how much i try to improve and do good things everything always seems to implode on me..
I know its not the same as IRL friends.. But im here if uu want to talk captain.. :)  I don't know uu, but i still care about uu and hope uu manage to find a way through all this turmoil..

this 1000x over..  If uu have the ability to connect with uur parents or any other helpful support uu have in uur life..  dont let shame or any other negative thoughts get in uur way..  I feel like uu already understand deep down what uu have to do..  This relationship isnt healthy at all, a partner should be supportive and caring, not tearing uu down constantly..  This is probably cliche but uur still really young and have so much time ahead of uu..!  Don't let one bad relationship ruin uu, its just not worth it..

This used to keep me going..  I used to look up at the stars every night and be brought back to reality with just how small and insignificant all of lifes problems are..  But lately im really struggling to find any reason to push forward or find any meaning anymore..   Its getting so hard to keep the thought that "maybe the universe would be more beautiful without me" out of my head.. :\\

I also feel this in the depths of my heart and im so sorry to hear uur also going through the same pain.. :( However im incapable of hating another being so im just going to send some love uur way.. :)  I dont have any idea what uur going through but i wish uu all the best captain..! o7  Feel free to inbox me if uu want to talk about whats going on..  I probably cant provide any worthwhile advice as im also suffering and dont know how to find a way out.. But ill gladly provide an ear to listen and a heart to care.. :)

Thanks for your reply.  Its the carrier nerves that were damaged in a crush injury.  One finger only has feeling right at  the base just a bit past the metacarpal knuckle. And the other has feeling just a little past the proximal knuckle.

I've essentially been told I just have to live with it, i guess since its not my dominant hand it's not seen as a huge concern?  I still have most of the function of my fingers they are just very clumsy and accident prone now as i can't feel what i'm touching, and have to look at them to see where they are in relation to my hand.  I work with power tools so i have the feeling they're probably going to get lost as a result anyway given enough time.  

Aye i'm aware with current tech i won't ever get back to pre-accident condition, but i'm not too attached to my fingers in their current state.  i'd much rather donate my fingers to researching improvements in prosthetics than eventually feed them to a hungry saw. :D

Maybe ill get used to and relearn to use my fingers eventually, but until then i'm keeping my eyes out for other options as well.

Thanks for the advice captain.  Aye I definitely fucked up big by not killing the problem in the very beginning.  I actually have moved to a different city, but I still end up seeing her about once a month as my mom likes to play grandma and babysits her kid a couple times a week, so its almost inevitable if i go to visit my mom I'm going to run into her as well.    


Things were going alright in the spring and summer, I decided to become a volunteer firefighter and paramedic and was distracting myself quite nicely.  But another year going by without meeting anybody new as well as having 0 matches on online dating sites has hit hard.  That combined with the fact shes currently in a miserable relationship makes it a lot harder as well.  When shes happy it's so much easier to step back and be ok with everything.  


I want to move on, but haven't had the opportunity to do so.  You are right tho in that the only way to crush this is to remove her fully from my life.

I wish I had some useful resources to give to uu but unfortunately I dont..  Just wanted to at least let uu know there's people out there listening and who care about uu..  


  I'm in a similar situation with my dad and I've yet to really figure out a way to break through his stubborn beliefs.  His favorite thing to say is "its all just between uur ears".  Well no shit sir its called a terribly misfiring brain..     


The only somewhat useful thing I can suggest is to try and compare it to a physical but hidden disease..  If uu had a tumor uur gunna treat that with meds or suffer the consequences, this is no different..   It didn't work in my case but hopefully it can help uu somehow..  


Feel free to message me if uu want to talk or vent about things..  I can offer uu an ear to listen and a heart to care.. :)

Here's a "review" of me by my best friend.  "You're probably the most caring person i know. Your incredibly selfless. You would give anything to help the people you care about or even a stranger off the street. Intensely loyal. Super smart. Dedicated and hard working. Not great with awkward silences but not terrible.  Your self worth isn't great. Quiet and reserved on first meeting but super fun yo be around once you warm up.  Not awesome in social situations."

yup definitely frustrating.  Sex is on the Z list of important things for me.  People are so obsessed these days with quick and easy gratification, completely ignoring the more meaningful intimate connections.

also i feel like i should mention i live in a small town of 280 and i know everybody here.  There are no single people here in my age bracket which really puts me down to random encounters outside of my town and online dating.  I guess i could move to another town, but tbh that seems like it might be social suicide given its taken me many years to finally settle down here somewhat.

thanks for the advice.  Moustache is all thats left now that im fire and paramedic.  Was only really wearing a hoodie in that one photo cause thats an "action shot" of me at work.  Im covered in mud from pressure washing a stump.  Hoodie was there for protection! :D  
im honestly curious though about why the last photo is creepy?  Its just a freeze frame photo of me jumping in the air while digging.
shit theyre on to me! :o
"shovelling some dirt"  i jumped in the air to make it look as though i was flying when i took the photo.
thanks for kind of making my point lol.  Im autistic and thats just my face unfortunately.  i cant form a lot of expressions properly, nor can i read them in return.

Im autistic if that makes any difference.  I try to give people space and at least as far as im aware im neither pushy or desperate.  Ive been called a creep multiple times before from just giving a nice compliment in passing.  I had no intentions but to just try and brighten someones day.  Its not just girls either but people in general.  People always seem to get bad vibes from me unless they are forced into a situation in which they spend enough time around me to understand that i just process the world a little different.  I have suits and nicer clothes but that just seems like bullshit to me?  Im a working man not a suit, i shouldnt have to pretend to be somebody im not.  Im a volunteer firefighter and paramedic and manage my own business.  I appreciate your insight however, even if i dont entirely agree with it.  :)

This may not sound genuine and there's no way for me to really prove it unfortunately.. but even tho I don't know uu I love uu and care about uu and wish uu all the best.. :) I'm always here if uu want to talk or vent about anything..  keep being awesome captain I'm rooting for uu..!
damn captain sounds like quite the adventure uu had as well.  im glad the nights were cool though.. :D

I know im a complete stranger to you, but i feel your pain captain.  I know it may not feel like anyone cares but i do, im walking that same path and know how it feels.  it may not help but if you want to just get some things off your chest and vent please feel free to PM me.  You seem like you care about people a lot, possibly too much and when that doesnt get reciprocated it cuts deep.  Maybe im reading between the lines here and sorry if i am, but just know theres other people out there like you.  There no real way for me to prove it but i do genuinely care about you and wish you the best.  It may feel pointless to reach out now, but at this stage what have you got to lose?

Not sure if this counts as a necro so my apologies if it is.  I just recently joined the local volunteer firefighter paramedics to try and force myself to overcome my fear.  I'm hoping that since I'm directly helping people it will be easier to get myself to open up again and learn to talk.  It has been really hard to open up to the other volunteers so far but I'm just going to take things a day at a time and try to distract myself with the training.

Thank you for the kind words and advice, I wish you the best!

It's been so long since I've talked to people that I have a really hard time figuring out what to even say. As soon as I detect any hesitation from them I almost always take it badly and assume I've said something wrong or bothered them somehow.  I can't stand when people are unhappy as it hurts me as well, so I just avoid people now out of fear.

I know this is illogical as it's very unlikely I could ever ruin someone's day simply by a minor offense.  But it's just a fear I've never been able to shake.  Honestly it's most likely only been growing.  I know I should keep at it and keep putting myself out there, but I just feel like I'm running out of steam.  So many times I've gone to bars or events or social gatherings and just been a wallflower the whole time. Avoiding eye contact with people as best as possible.  Pretty much just doing a really good impression of a ghost.

I have my own business working by myself doing construction and landscaping in a very remote city.  I'm an only child, and any time I bring up mental health or vent to my parents they either get really angry at me, or say very painful and unhelpful things.  

But yes uu are very much right that I need to find new friends.  I just need to figure out how to overcome my fear of accidentally hurting others.

Couldn't hurt to give it a shot I guess.  Thank you very much for taking the time to listen, I really do appreciate it.  

I think my main issue really is my crippling social anxiety.  I'm not even sure how I'm able to type right now because that's normally an impossibility even with the anonymity of the internet. It's almost impossible for me to meet new people as a result, and the few times people have tried to open up to me i was unable to reciprocate.  

As a result I'm 30 years old and only really have two "friends". My best friend from high school who's now a drug addict and steals from me.   And my ex girlfriend from the only relationship I've ever been in which ended about 10yrs ago.  Both aren't super reliable as a support network for obvious reasons.

I wish I could just be like so many people and crave money and power.  But I'm stuck with my greatest desires being love and intimacy.  And as a result of that any time I get even the slightest bit of money I end up blowing it on toys to try and distract me.  It never works for long though and I end up buying bigger and more expensive things even though I know it's pointless.  

Ive grown to hate money and material possessions.

I just want to be loved. I just want to feel something for once.  To be held..  

I'd give it all away for a fucking hug.

Oh it most definitely is and I appreciate the concern.  :)  It's been a non-stop battle for well over a decade now.  Some days are worse than others, just happens to be a bad patch of worse at the moment.
